correctness.rationale: PASS. Under merged independent rate-one Poisson coupon clocks, conditioning on maximum first-arrival M=m leaves the last type singleton and the others independent positive-truncated Poisson counts, hence U|M=m=1+Bin(n-1,m/(exp(m)-1)). For m=log n+O(1) its conditional mean/variance are log n exp(-(m-log n))+O(1), yielding a uniform window Berry-Esseen estimate and a Gaussian residual asymptotically independent of the Gumbel first-arrival extreme. For the original discrete completion count, E(M-T/n)^2=H_n/n and log n times its scale error is o_p(sqrt(log n)), giving the claimed observed-time studentization. Independently checked 35 exact rational pmf entries using distinct absorbing chain and integrated Poisson identities for n=2..8; finite checks are not evidence for infinite n alone.
